about: Everything an agent (or the Machines tab) may run on a worker Mac. Nothing outside this list runs. kinds: shell = fixed command; open-url = open a link in the default browser; script = a file from ~/agent-hub-jobs on that Mac; claude = a headless Claude Code task on that Mac, using its own Claude login.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Uptime, disk, macOS version and whether Claude Code is installed.
actions.command: uptime; df -h / | tail -1; sw_vers -productVersion; (command -v claude >/dev/null && claude --version) || echo 'claude: not installed'

actions.label: Who is signed in
actions.description: The macOS user and whether the screen is locked.
actions.command: whoami; hostname; python3 -c "import Quartz;print('screen locked' if Quartz.CGSessionCopyCurrentDictionary().get('CGSSessionScreenIsLocked') else 'screen unlocked')" 2>/dev/null || echo 'lock state unknown'

actions.label: Open a URL
actions.description: Open a web page in that Mac's default browser (for a signed-in session there).

actions.label: Run a saved script
actions.description: Run a shell script from ~/agent-hub-jobs on that Mac. Put scripts there yourself; agents can only run what exists.

actions.label: Claude Code task
actions.description: Give that Mac's Claude Code a task to do on its own (headless), in ~/agent-hub-jobs/work. Uses that Mac's Claude subscription login.
